column3: Close to the Greek; NKJV supplies “covenant” after “the first,” where the Greek has no noun (some Textus Receptus editions add “tabernacle”).
NKJV has “the good things to come,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “the good things that have come.”
NKJV has “your conscience,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “our conscience.”
